_doc: NOT APPLIED. Heal proposal for the EBIT-in-op-slot class (runbook §129): each stored opS equals MC after-dep EBIT to the paisa with ebitS empty. ebitS_new = the stored value (moves to slot 7); opS_new = MC op_pre where GATE E (PAT-vintage) passed, else null (ebit-move-only). A §2b correction: needs the user decision and a correction applier; apply_agg_fills is fill-only and cannot write it.
